Title: Public Preview: Container insights support for AKS hybrid clusters

Body.Content:
Container insights support for AKS hybrid clusters is now in public preview.

With AKS hybrid cluster support, you can now enable Azure Monitor container insights for your lifecycle managed AKS on Azure Stack HCI.

With container insights, you can:

  • Identify key resource bottlenecks through the various containers and their resource utilization.
  • View and analyze the overall controller or pod performance.
  • Configure alerts to proactively notify you when your resource utilization exceeds desired thresholds.

Learn More:

Container Insights Docs: https://aka.ms/provisionedclustermonitoring

Pricing comparison: https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/
